blueskyPosts.text: The Gateway Development Commission will hold a public Board meeting on June 1, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. Registration and public comment information can be found here: www.gatewayprogram.org/board-meetin...

Assembling tunnel boring machines is no small undertaking. Before these massive machines can begin digging, they have to be transported, delivered, and assembled.

STV, part of the Hudson Tunnel Project delivery team, explains what goes into getting these complex machines ready to launch.

🚧Construction Update🚧

The HYCC-3 Project has entered a new phase: adding the roof to the tunnel box. 

We do this by filling the tunnel with sand and pouring concrete over it, then removing the sand once the concrete hardens. The end result: a fully enclosed box trains can travel through.

Our Chief Engineer has worked on tunneling projects all over the world. Hear him explain what it takes to tunnel through the Palisades cliffs and see the progress we're making on assembling the machines that will get the job done in this new report from @nbcnewyork.com

Tunnel boring machines are massive, complex pieces of equipment, and we're building two in New Jersey! Click the link to see what it takes to assemble these complex machines and go inside the launch box where they will begin digging through the hard rock of the Palisades.

Did you know that the Palisades made of some of the hardest rock on earth? @fox5ny.bsky.social takes you behind the scenes of the work happening now to assemble our custom-built tunnel boring machines that will break through this rock. Click the link to learn more.

1910: Picks and Shovels

2026: Huge high-tech machines 

Click the link to learn more about how we'll bore the new rail tunnel under the Hudson River with machines up to the task.

Five active construction sites. Hundreds of workers. One much-needed upgrade to our rail network. 

We just added new pictures from our construction sites to our photo gallery. Click the link to see the progress we made in April.

www.gatewayprogram.org/photo-galler...

Big infrastructure project, meet the next generation 🤝

GDC's Community Engagement team recently visited two North Bergen elementary schools to teach more than 400 students about the Hudson Tunnel Project and work happening in their neighborhoods.

On International Workers' Day, GDC recognizes the skilled workforce moving the Hudson Tunnel Project forward.

This project depends on the workers on our construction sites every day. We're grateful for their role in building infrastructure that will serve the region for generations.
